findings: Inconsistent badge selector in storage listener — The window.addEventListener('storage', ...) block at line 277 of main.js selects the badge with document.querySelector('.cart-fab .badge-count') rather than the id='cart-fab-badge' that was specifically added for stable targeting. The class selector still resolves correctly so this does not break badge visibility, but the id is unused. Update the storage listener (and optionally the three AJAX handlers) to use document.getElementById('cart-fab-badge').
